cases.name: the dev pack is gone (D114, amended): no folder, no definition, no pack list naming it, no file of the harness naming its two test skills, nothing of the spec, plan, batch and audit chain in the hooks - and the profile dev stays, as core, source, quality, usage
cases.cmd:
H={{CLAUDE}}/..; [ -d "$H/packs" ] || { printf 'ok (skipped: no packs/ beside claude/ - a deployed harness)'; exit 0; }; [ -e "$H/packs/dev" ] && printf 'BAD-pack-folder '; [ -e "$H/profiles/packs/dev.yaml" ] && printf 'BAD-pack-definition '; grep -qx 'packs: \[core, source, quality, usage\]' "$H/profiles/dev.yaml" || printf 'BAD-profile '; grep -lE '^(packs|with):.*[[ ]dev[],]' "$H"/profiles/*.yaml "$H"/profiles/packs/*.yaml | sed 's/^/BAD-listed:/' | tr '
' ' '; grep -rlE 'dev-unit-tests|dev-integration-tests|packs/dev/' "$H" --exclude-dir=evals --exclude-dir=.fixtures --exclude=VERIFICATIONS.md | sed 's/^/BAD-test-skill:/' | tr '
' ' '; grep -rlE '/dev-(spec|change|plan|implement|verify|batches|status|learn)|dev-test-author|dev-auditor|dev-implementer|adversarial-reviewer' {{CLAUDE}}/hooks {{CLAUDE}}/lib {{CLAUDE}}/settings.json | sed 's/^/BAD-mention:/' | tr '
' ' '; printf 'ok'
